build.beforeDevCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then npm --prefix frontend run dev; else npm --prefix ../frontend run dev; fi
build.beforeBuildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then npm --prefix frontend run build; else npm --prefix ../frontend run build; fi

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:8787; img-src 'self' asset: https://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
